semantics.exact_factorization: requires absent-feature Mobius coefficients to be exactly zero
semantics.decision_preserving_factorization: requires dropping a feature never to change the selected constructor

contrast_codata.criterion: feature f is droppable only if every Mobius coefficient whose subset contains f is exactly zero

constructor_ordering.criterion: feature f is droppable only if the strict constructor order is constant on every f-fiber

selected_injection.criterion: feature f is droppable only if argmax is constant on every f-fiber

scope.establishes: the complete sampled controller/attractor number Mobius support and per-context contrast-codata, ordering, and choice demand sets for the singular/plural verb family
scope.does_not_yet_establish: the remaining feature lattice or polynomial substitution closure
scope.interpretation: choice-relevant A is malformed attractor demand; nonzero D_C D_A makes that dependence nonseparable but is not intrinsically erroneous
